title: Efficacy of antihypertensive treatment for target organ protection in patients with masked hypertension (ANTI-MASK): a multicentre, double-blind, placebo-controlled trial
time_scope: Baseline to the primary 48-week/final follow-up assessment.
excluded: Individual LVH outcomes, separate component responder categories and intermediate visits
Blood pressure, per-protocol analyses, quality of life and safety
population_or_material: The randomized ANTI-MASK ITT population with masked hypertension and baseline target organ damage.
requested_items: Composite improvement counts/proportions and main comparison; main Table 3 baseline summaries, adjusted arm changes and treatment contrasts for baPWV/ACR. Exclude separate responder endpoints for composite components.
